scope: Dried/canned and other cooking-relevant mung-bean forms
Dried/canned and other cooking-relevant adzuki-bean forms
Dried/canned and other cooking-relevant lima-bean forms
Dried/canned and other cooking-relevant black-eyed-pea forms
decisions.rationale: None of these four bean families is in the accepted 222-identity catalog. The unbounded beans query already has 12 primary results. Add them through a future exact identity/source/coverage batch with reviewed navigation; truncation is not grouping.
decisions.revisit: Before expanding the beans category; approve compact family/form navigation and exact identities first.
decisions.appliesTo: v1.6.1 release scope only; reconsider with the stated next category review or a relevant source release. No ingredient retirement, inventory deletion, permanent exclusion or automatic future activation.
